tasks.subject: Task 0: Confirm doc paths and capture baseline
tasks.description: Resolved: user-facing recap doc is `docs/session-tracking.md` (single file). No `docs/dev/session-recap.md` exists; design specs serve as the architectural reference. DEFAULT_DATA shape recorded.

tasks.subject: Task 1: Fix XP breakdown snapshot order (Bug 1)
tasks.description: Snapshot built before `this.questions` reset. Verified live: logXp persists `questions: [{label, xp, count}]` correctly.

tasks.subject: Task 2: Snapshot enemy roster & rounds during active combats (Bug 2 prep)
tasks.description: _snapshotEnemies helper added. combatStart captures initial roster + rounds. updateCombat refreshes snapshot. _activeCombats entries now carry { startTime, participants, rounds, enemies, lastSnapshotAt }.

tasks.subject: Task 3: Flush active combats on session end/pause + loosen deleteCombat guard (Bug 2 fix)
tasks.description: _flushActiveCombats added. Wired into endAndSave and pauseSession. deleteCombat handler no longer guards on sessionState — proceeds when _activeCombats.has(id). Verified live with synthetic active combat + kill map.

tasks.subject: Task 4: Extract shared currency formatter
tasks.description: _toCopper and _formatCurrency helpers added. Loot rendering NOT refactored — preserves byte-identical comma-separated output for existing recaps. Sales/Purchases use the new helpers (space-separated, matching merchant chat format).

tasks.subject: Task 5: Add logSale / logPurchase data layer (Bug 3 part 1)
tasks.description: DEFAULT_DATA extended with sales:[] and purchases:[]. getData() backfills missing arrays for existing worlds. logSale and logPurchase methods added with sessionState self-guards. endAndSave snapshot includes both new arrays.

tasks.subject: Task 6: Wire merchant-shop into recap loggers (Bug 3 part 2)
tasks.description: SessionRecap import added to merchant-shop. logTransaction now forwards to logSale (with sell ratio) or logPurchase based on entry.action. All four merchant paths (buy/catalogBuy/gamble/sell) covered via this single chokepoint.

tasks.subject: Task 7: Render Sales and Purchases sections (Bug 3 part 3)
tasks.description: Sales and Purchases sections added to formatForDiscordFromData after Loot, before XP. Both grouped by player with subtotals + party total. Sales show ratio% only when !=100. Sections only render when arrays non-empty. Verified live with synthetic data.

tasks.subject: Task 8: Update documentation
tasks.description: docs/session-tracking.md updated: new sections in tab list, settings table includes sales/purchases, gotcha entries for combat flush + merchant-feeds-recap. CHANGELOG.md v1.16.2 entry added covering all three fixes. module.json + README badge bumped to 1.16.2. Skipped creating new docs/dev/session-recap.md — design specs cover the architecture reference.
